TC01_normal_success.purpose: A normal success and one isolated failure should not alert.

TC02_below_threshold.purpose: Four failures in the window are below the threshold of five.

TC03_same_account_guessing.purpose: Five rapid failures against one account from one IP should alert.

TC04_password_spray.purpose: Five rapid failures against different accounts from one IP should alert.

TC05_spread_over_time.purpose: Five failures spread out so no five fit in one rolling window should not alert.

TC06_distributed_sources.purpose: Four failures from each of two IPs demonstrate the single-IP rule's distributed-attempt blind spot.

TC07_shared_nat_false_positive_risk.purpose: Five failures behind a shared address should technically alert, but may be benign; validate triage/tuning.
